boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten documented, under-21-safe UCF activities with no admission charge or no additional cost for eligible current students.

cards.title: Take a self-guided Arboretum tour
cards.subtitle: UCF Arboretum natural areas
cards.notes: Start with the Arboretum’s self-guided-tour information, then set an easy pace through the natural areas. Stay on permitted paths and leave plants where they grow.
cards.short_summary: A flexible outdoor walk through UCF’s campus natural areas.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF offers self-guided Arboretum tours, and its natural areas and trails are open to the public daily with no admission charge.
cards.access_notes: Open sunrise to sunset every day; no admission charge. Donations are appreciated.

cards.title: Walk the Arboretum trails
cards.subtitle: UCF Arboretum natural areas
cards.notes: Meet for a daylight trail walk and choose a turnaround point before you begin. Bring water, follow posted rules, and skip collecting any plant material.
cards.short_summary: A no-admission nature hang on campus trails.
cards.evidence_claim: The UCF Arboretum’s natural areas and trails are open to the public from sunrise to sunset every day of the year, with no admission charge.
cards.access_notes: Open sunrise to sunset daily; no admission charge. Camping, fires, and barbecues are prohibited.

cards.title: See the UCF Art Gallery exhibition
cards.subtitle: Visual Arts Building, Room 140
cards.notes: Drop into the Visual Arts Building during gallery hours and spend time with the current exhibition. Check the gallery page before going because exhibitions change.
cards.short_summary: Free visual-art viewing on the main campus.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF Art Gallery is in the Visual Arts Building on UCF’s main campus and admission is free.
cards.source_title: About the Gallery | UCF Art Gallery
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Friday, 10 a.m.-5 p.m.; closed on major holidays. Gallery admission is free.

cards.title: Attend a gallery reception
cards.subtitle: UCF Art Gallery, Visual Arts Building
cards.notes: Watch the gallery calendar for a reception, then arrive during the listed window to view the work and talk about it with your group. Confirm dates before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A free, public-facing art reception when one is scheduled.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF states that Art Gallery receptions are typically held 5-7 p.m. and are free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Ticketing Information - UCF College of Arts and Humanities
cards.access_notes: Receptions are typically 5-7 p.m.; verify the current exhibition calendar before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Recreation and Wellness Center Fitness Workout
cards.title: Work out at the RWC
cards.subtitle: Recreation and Wellness Center main facility
cards.notes: Bring your UCF ID and make a simple workout date at the Recreation and Wellness Center. Pick equipment appropriate to your experience and follow facility guidance.
cards.short_summary: A student-access fitness session with no additional membership charge.
cards.evidence_claim: Students who have paid the Activity and Service Fee have unlimited membership to all RWC facilities at no cost.
cards.access_notes: For current fee-paying UCF students; valid picture ID is required for entry.

cards.entity_name: Recreation and Wellness Center Leisure Pool Swim
cards.title: Meet at the RWC Leisure Pool
cards.subtitle: Recreation and Wellness Center main facility
cards.notes: Coordinate a swim session at the Leisure Pool and check RWC facility guidance before leaving. Use the pool only when it is open and follow lifeguard instructions.
cards.short_summary: A no-extra-cost pool hang for eligible UCF students.
cards.evidence_claim: The RWC lists its Leisure Pool among its facilities, and eligible fee-paying UCF students have unlimited RWC membership at no cost.
cards.access_notes: For current fee-paying UCF students with RWC access; confirm pool availability before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Recreation and Wellness Center Lap Pool Swim
cards.title: Swim laps at the RWC
cards.subtitle: Recreation and Wellness Center main facility
cards.notes: Bring a friend for a low-key lap-swim session, choosing a lane that matches your pace. Check the RWC schedule and comply with posted aquatics rules.
cards.short_summary: Use the campus lap pool without an additional facility charge.
cards.evidence_claim: The RWC lists a nine-lane regulation lap pool among its amenities, and eligible fee-paying UCF students have unlimited RWC membership at no cost.
cards.access_notes: For current fee-paying UCF students with RWC access; check aquatics availability before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Recreation and Wellness Center Indoor Track Walk
cards.title: Walk the RWC indoor track
cards.subtitle: Recreation and Wellness Center main facility
cards.notes: Set a conversation-friendly walking pace on the indoor track and agree on a lap count or time goal. Bring your UCF ID and observe posted facility etiquette.
cards.short_summary: A weather-proof walk using student RWC access.
cards.evidence_claim: The RWC lists a one-eighth-mile track among its amenities, and eligible fee-paying UCF students have unlimited RWC membership at no cost.
cards.access_notes: For current fee-paying UCF students with RWC access; valid picture ID is required for entry.

cards.entity_name: Recreation and Wellness Center Basketball Court Game
cards.title: Play a pickup basketball game
cards.subtitle: Recreation and Wellness Center main facility
cards.notes: Gather a small group for a casual game on the RWC courts, sharing the space respectfully with other users. Check the facility schedule and bring student ID.
cards.short_summary: Indoor court time through eligible student RWC access.
cards.evidence_claim: The RWC lists multipurpose courts among its amenities, and eligible fee-paying UCF students have unlimited RWC membership at no cost.
cards.access_notes: For current fee-paying UCF students with RWC access; court availability may vary by programming.

cards.title: Paddle Lake Claire
cards.subtitle: William E. and Mary Jo Davis Recreation Area at Lake Claire
cards.notes: Use an active student ID to check out a kayak, canoe, or paddleboard at Lake Claire. Follow boathouse instructions; swimming, fishing, and personal watercraft are prohibited.
cards.short_summary: Free student equipment rental at UCF’s Lake Claire recreation area.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF says current students with active student ID can rent Lake Claire equipment, including kayaks, canoes, and paddleboards, for free.
cards.source_title: The William E. and Mary Jo Davis Recreation Area at Lake Claire
cards.access_notes: Anyone may go to Lake Claire, but equipment rental is for current UCF students with active student ID; no guest passes currently.
